title: FragmentSender ACK and timeout state transitions are unsynchronized
description: python/src/lichen/schc/fragment.py mutates sender state/attempts and finishes manager records outside a sender-level transaction. Concurrent ACK/timeout paths may retransmit after success or conflict. Serialize state transitions and manager acceptance/finish; add threaded barrier tests for C=1 vs C=0 and ACK vs timeout.
notes: Post-fix review: FragmentSender lock serializes sender methods, but manager receipt acceptance/touch and semantic status/attempt/finish are still separate security-lock transactions. Rotation can interleave after accept_ack/touch and before finish/return, allowing an old-key retransmission after rekey or a consumed ACK followed by finish failure. Make ACK/timeout semantic transition and manager record mutation one transaction with lock ordering tests.
